title: Methods Of GDP Calculations
definition: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) represents the monetary value of all final goods and services produced within a country's geographic borders over a specific period, computed primarily through the Output (Value Added), Income, and Expenditure approaches.
importanceInUpsc: Fundamental core microtopic in Indian Economy tested repeatedly in Prelims (concept clarity on GVA, Factor Cost vs. Market Price, base year revisions) and Mains GS-3 (economic growth measurement, structural reforms, statistical adequacy).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Methods Of GDP Calculations.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Difference between intermediate and final goods
